title: What a capture is, who the second reader asks about each record, and rules it had stated more widely than the primaries
note: AUD-062 to AUD-067. A capture is the runner's, made while its task executes, in the origin view, the duplicate's answer, the second reader's task replay and the decision proof (SR1 to SR8); an authenticator given to the second reader reaches the task and subsystem replays it consults (SR9 to SR13); a HUMAN is admitted by the bootstrap or an active human (SR14, SR15); a move from a state the replay does not have is refused (SR16, SR17); a policy version is an integer (SR18); an allowed read asks of every ancestor (SR19, SR20). tests/test_second_reader_rules.py holds each.
